verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents an in-product conversational AI assistant that answers questions about and summarizes selected files or knowledge bases. A customer quote also describes natural-language querying and comparison across multiple documents, which covers the 'insights from my data' core of the story. Proactive AI suggestions or recommendations surfaced from the data are not documented, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated suggestions/recommendations from user data, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Conversational AI assistant capable of answering questions and summarizing multiple selected files or knowledge bases
Now, our brokers can query across multiple documents in natural language to search for terms and conditions and compare files.
semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords
